literal_meaning: গলায় আঁকশি বসানো বা দেওয়া (to put a hook on the neck)
figurative_meaning_en: To force someone into obligation by settling their debt
similar_in_english: To have someone on the hook
To hold a mortgage on someone
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে তার ঋণ শোধ করে গলায় আঁকশি দিয়েছে, এখন সব কাজ করাতে হবে।
ব্যবসায়ীটি কর্মচারীর পুরনো ঋণ মিটিয়ে গলায় আঁকশি দিয়েছে।
example_sentences_in_english: He paid off his debt and now has him on the hook for favors.
The businessman settled the worker's old loan, putting a hook around his neck.
note: This idiom draws from the imagery of fishing hooks, symbolizing inescapable control through financial leverage in everyday Bengali life.
